selection: Closest GHCND station with>=90percent valid unflagged daily coverage for each variable, inspected in distance order; prefer complete calendar record for matched forecastcomparisons; no generation outcomes used
monthly_aggregation: Mean TMAX/TMIN inCelsius, totalPRCPmm; eachmonthlyfeature requires>=90percent of calendar days valid; no imputation
availability: Monthlyend+14day assumption; GHCNDupdateddaily but original historical publication timestamps are not preserved
